Name: Sliding Puzzle
Author: Home Deck
Description: Turn a block of keys into a classic 15-puzzle. Slide numbered tiles into the empty gap to put them back in order — solve it and the board flashes green, then shuffles itself for another round.

Actions.Name: Tile
Actions.Tooltip: One square of the sliding puzzle. Place these in a solid rectangular block on a folder page — one tile becomes the empty gap automatically.
